reason: Article 21(1)(e)(iv) of the DORA Delegated Regulation requires entities to review access rights at least every six months for systems supporting critical or important functions, which directly matches the control objective.
applicability_note: This control is applicable to all financial entities under DORA that operate systems supporting critical or important functions.
challenge_comment: The mapping is direct and sufficient; no additional provisions are needed to support the stated control objective.
